tc11_ledger.chain_law: TC11's law, not forward_log's: line_sha256 = sha256(canonical JSON of the line without line_sha256), `prev` INSIDE the line (genesis: the zeros), canonical = sort_keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii False, allow_nan False, written compact. Under forward_log.canonical a field named line_sha256 would be hashed into its own digest, so this head cannot be a prev_sha256 of TC12's chain: the file is CITED, never appended, never continued.

gate.text_of_record: `scored` (the treated arm) — `base` minus the refused set, a POST-FILTER: the same Trade objects in the base's order, keyed (symbol, entry_ms), and no entry admitted into a slot a refusal frees (no re-ride). A base campaign is refused iff (i) its tide band at the ENTRY bar is OLD — the two-state tide run `tierc7_lab_regime.tide_streak(symbol)[1][entry_i]` (EMA periods `tierc7_rules.TIDE_FAST` and `tierc7_rules.TIDE_SLOW`; the flip bar counts as bar 1) is `>=` the top edge of `tierc9._trailing_edges(pool, open_ms[entry_i])["streak_bar"]`, the quantiles `tierc7_lab_regime.STREAK_BAND_QUANTILES` of the home-panel bar pool `tierc9._trailing_pool(pool_lo_ms, pin − 1)` (`pin` = the as-of pin of the ride; the edge at an entry does not depend on it) restricted to bars with open `<=` the entry bar's open, defined once that prefix holds `tierc7_rules.PROVISIONAL_MIN_N` bars, `pool_lo_ms` read from `research_outputs/tierc12/x_rec/tierc11x/forward/BOOK_SPECS.json` key `pool_lo_ms` — OR (ii) its window age `entry_i − arm_i` (4h bars) is `>=` the cut read from the text of record of TC11's registration P-WIN-1 (`research_outputs/tierc11/registrations/REGISTRATIONS.json`) and asserted equal to the contract's (:54). The OR is inclusive: a campaign both OLD and stale is refused once. An entry bar whose trailing edges are undefined HALTs — it is never 'not refused'.

chain.law: entry_sha256 = forward_log.chain_hash(line, prev) = sha256(forward_log.canonical(line) + prev); canonical strips only entry_sha256; written by forward_log.append_entry, verified by forward_log.verify_chain
structure_law: S2 every line kind is one of X's chain.kinds
S3 the raw bytes of the first lines are X's ledger (the prefix law is on bytes); they open X's book_order in order and name X's spec sha; the line after them is X's refresh

S4 exactly ONE book_open follows X's lines; it is the next line; its book is the fourth id; its spec_sha256 is the sha of the bytes of BOOK_SPEC_COMBINED.json and differs from X's spec sha; its opening_ms and n_min equal those of X's book_open lines
S5 every row line names one of the four books, carries exactly row_fields + row_fields_added + the two chain fields, and no (book, symbol, entry_ms) occurs twice
S6 the pins of the refresh lines strictly increase; the file never ends on a row line; inside one refresh block rows stand in book order, then (entry_close_ms, symbol)
S7 every row of a gated book has, earlier in the file, the base row of the same key, equal on every field but `book`
